visual.general_description: Color photograph of an abdomen with skin scarring and discoloration, overlaid with colored lines, arrows, a shaded region and letters A to E, labelled Cephalad at the top and Caudad at the bottom.
visual.detailed_description: The image shows an abdominal skin surface with patchy yellow-green, pink and brown discoloration and scarring. The word Cephalad is printed near the top and Caudad near the bottom. A light-blue line runs from a short black bar labelled A in a curve to a black bar labelled B; a light-blue dashed arrow continues from B downward toward Caudad. A dark-blue solid curved line joins black bars labelled C, D and E, and a dark-blue dashed arrow runs from C downward toward Caudad. A red dot sits in the upper part of the shaded area and a red curved arrow runs from it toward the bar labelled D near the right edge of the image. A semi-transparent pink-red shaded area covers the part of the abdomen in the right half of the image, around C, D and E, and does not extend over A and B. A clear tube leaves the skin near the E bar and runs toward the lower right of the frame ending in a connector. A white cable lies at the top left edge and brown staining or dressing is at the right edge near D. No face, genitalia, printed dates, names or device text is visible.
